column1: # The altered sets that try_altered_copies.py makes from ../accepted-proof: one row for each set, five columns
# separated by tabs. Empty lines and lines that begin with # are skipped.
# description   what the script prints for the row
# file          the file of ../accepted-proof that is altered: example.proof, example.req, example.y, ivk/key.bin,
#               ivk/leaf/0.bin, config/policy.txt, config/KL.bin, config/layout.txt; or ID.txt for the value after -id
# place         first, middle, last: that byte (in ID.txt: that digit).  byte N: byte N, counted from 0.
#               token N: the lowest byte of the 32-bit word N.  token first-checked (example.req only): the first
#               reply token that the proof checks.
#               field NAME (example.proof only): the first byte of the field of that name in the list that
#               "cp_verify -plan request ... -fields" prints; only a field whose place the list gives as exact
#               ("at", not "at-most"). Where several fields have that name, add which: "field NAME #2" is the second.
#               end: behind the last byte.
# change        flip: the byte's lowest bit.  put HEX: write these bytes over the bytes that start there.
#               put HEX over HEX: the same, and the second HEX, of the same number of bytes, says what must stand there before.
#               cut: remove that byte and all behind it.  append HEX: add these bytes (place: end).
#               other-digit: another hex digit (ID.txt only).
# last line     the last line that the verifier must print; it begins with "NO: "
# Every proof, key.bin and leaf file has other bytes, and most of their fields lie at other places. So a row with
# "byte N" fits one stored file alone: write it with "put HEX over HEX", and the script refuses it on another file.
one bit of the proof changed
the proof's last byte cut off
one byte added to the proof
one bit of ivk/key.bin changed
one bit of ivk/leaf/0.bin changed
a prompt token changed
a checked reply token changed
another token after the request
another scale in KL.bin
another commitment ID
